Một cờ ở Unit (và ở `template` của Workflow): `blind: true` làm *mọi vai* của Unit chạy với `hostRead: blind` (`docs/specs/confinement-authority.md` §9.2): worker không đọc được `.fgos/assignments`, `.fgos/workflow-runs`, `.fgos/dispatch-runs` của project, thư mục socket herdr, private home của dispatch khác, hay `/proc/<pid>` của tiến trình anh em; chỉ đọc được thư mục của chính nó (brief, ref đã được trao — chỉ-đọc) và ghi outbox. Phần còn lại của host (repo, `node`, DNS) và file tracked trong `.fgos` không đổi. Unit `blind` không bao giờ chạy không-blind: nếu không thực thi được — `bind()` không chọn in-process/inline, không có bwrap, mode không `required`, probe hỏng/chưa tươi, `cwd` hay ref nằm trong vùng bị che — dispatch bị từ chối trước khi spawn với lý do có tên (`blind-in-process`, `blind-requires-confinement`, `blind-hides-workspace`, `blind-ref-hidden`, `confinement-probe-failed`, ...). Với Unit `blind`, input `unit-run:`/`gate-answer:` (và ref bất kỳ nằm trong vùng bị che) không được giao bằng đường dẫn gốc: lúc dispatch, `resolveUnitInputs` + `copyHandoffsInto` chép nguyên byte (kiểm sha256) vào `inputs/` của round dir của chính vai đó, mỗi vai một bản, tên trung tính khi có `anonymizeInputs`; `unit.json` giữ `inputMap`, resume dùng lại bản chép. `blind-ref-hidden` chỉ còn cho ref không chép được. Workflow bật `blind`: hai bước panel của `delphi` (`propose-round-1`, `propose-round-2`), `generate-ideas` của `nominal-group`, `sense-making-panel` của `group-cognition`, `shaping` của `architecture-advisory` (`core/workflows/architecture-advisory.yaml`) và `perspectives` của `business-discussion` (`core/workflows/business-discussion.yaml`).

payload.sourceLineAtOldCoordinate: - **RUL77 ([ĐÃ BỊ THAY phần "each door carries one posture lane" bởi RUL90 (the raw dispatch doors are removed), decision 0062 — posture now comes from the Unit's `writes` plus the capability; "an agent executor declares no `for`" stands] posture belongs to the capability, an agent executor declares no `for`, and each door carries one posture lane; supersedes RUL76 (`execute <id> --for <capability>` with a "must declare" gate), 2026-10-13).** An agent executor can do any kind of work, so no `for` list describes it, and a list on one was read as the posture of every dispatch to it (`docs/specs/confinement-authority.md` already said a direct executor call must carry a capability anchor and never infer the minimum from `executor.for`). `resolveCapabilityDetailsFromHints` reads `for` from tool executors only; on an agent executor it is inert (config still loads, so projects and worktrees that carry one keep dispatching) and `fgos doctor` names it under `executor-profile-warnings` (`executor.<id>.agent-for-inert`); the agent executors' `for` lists are gone from this repo's `.fgos/config.json` (`decide --for` routing unchanged: it reads `capabilities.<name>.prefer`). The CLI door `execute <agent>` refuses before spawning when no `--for` is given (`capability-required`, listing the writing capabilities and the read-only door); programmatic callers (Assignment, Work) pass their own capability hints and are unchanged. `execute <agent> --for <capability>` runs the invocation that capability `prefer`s for that executor, else the first plain cli invocation with no sandbox backend, instead of always the first cli invocation. That door leases no provider account, so it carries writing work only: a capability with required confinement is refused (`posture-needs-assignment`). Read-only work runs sandboxed as a Workflow unit with `writes: []` (`fgos workflow start --units`), which binds the read-only posture and leases the account (the architecture-advisory seats ran that way: `confined-bwrap`, login provisioned); `execute --contract <file> --executor <id>` keeps a named provider and leases its account but runs unconfined, read-only by instruction only (measured: `execute openai --for code:review` on the bare door ran `codex-cli-bwrap` confined and got 401 with no login; the same read through `--contract --executor openai` answered, on `cli-spawn` with `confinement: null`). A sandboxed read-only door that also keeps a named provider does not exist yet. The calling agent answers Q1 (does it write? does a provider matter?) from prose doctrine in `core/skills/_shared/capability-matching.md`, with no classifier or workflow generator. Decided after an `architecture-advisory` run (`wf-run-1791875339761-10315b91`: framing and shaping with three blind seats and a synthesizer completed; critique was blocked by a Codex trust prompt, so no reviewed synthesis exists). Not built: a soft provider hint on `decide` (`--prefer`, the synthesizer's recommendation) — naming the executor on `execute` already lets a caller pick a provider, and the hint would change `bind()`, shared with Workflow binding; revisit when a caller needs "this provider if it can, else any". Since 2026-10-14 (RUL88 (ad-hoc Unit prefer and persona, the one-liner), decision 0061) that hint exists on the Unit, not on `decide`: `fgos run "<prompt>" --provider <id>` and an ad-hoc Unit's `prefer` try the provider first and fail over into the pool, and a read-only one-liner is the sandboxed read-only door that keeps a preferred provider.
